about: Lux's run, frames 4, 5, 7 and 8: League's lux_run swings the wand upright behind her there, its gold end hanging beside her back foot. At game size that end (gold, white and skin-coloured pixels, no outline between) merged with the back leg and read as a deformed gold foot. The end is redrawn as the dark navy boot of the other frames, the wand's lower tip hidden behind the leg. import_native.py applies these edits after cutting the frames and stops if a pixel no longer has the colour an edit expects.
coords: x, y from the frame's pivot (the sheet canvas centre), then the colour expected there and the new colour
